```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(sf)
  library(rnaturalearth)
  library(rnaturalearthdata)
})


df <- read_csv("final_whale_shark.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# 2) World map (countries)
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# 3) Plot map + points (no boxplots)
p_map <- ggplot() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#d9f0ff", colour = NA), # ocean
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = world,
    fill = "#f2efe9",    
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    alpha = 0.25,
    size = 0.8,
    color = "#2b6cb0"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = range(df$lon, na.rm = TRUE),
    ylim = range(df$lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Whale shark locations",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  )

print(p_map)

```

```{r}



  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggExtra)

df <- read_csv("final_whale_shark.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lon), !is.na(lat))

# 2) Base scatter (middle points)
xlim <- range(df$lon, na.rm = TRUE)
ylim <- range(df$lat, na.rm = TRUE)

p_base <- ggplot(df, aes(x = lon, y = lat)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Whale shark locations Boxplot",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# 3) Add marginal boxplots (top + right) — aligned automatically
p_final <- ggMarginal(
  p_base,
  type = "boxplot",
  margins = "both",
  size = 6,
  outlier.alpha = 0.15
)

print(p_final)
mean(df$lon)
mean(df$lat)
```

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)


dat <- read_csv("final_whale_shark.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

gaps <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(str_remove(date, "Z"), tz = "UTC")  # 处理末尾Z
  ) %>%
  arrange(id, datetime) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(
    gap_hours = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "hours"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(gap_hours), gap_hours >= 0)

p_linear <- ggplot(gaps %>% filter(gap_hours <= 48), aes(gap_hours)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  labs(
    title = "Time gap distribution",
    x = "Time gap (hours, <= 48h shown)",
    y = "Count"
  )

print(p_linear)

p_log <- ggplot(gaps %>% filter(gap_hours > 0), aes(gap_hours)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Time gap distribution (log10 x-scale)",
    x = "Time gap (hours, log10 scale)",
    y = "Count"
  )

print(p_log)

gaps %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    min = min(gap_hours),
    p50 = quantile(gap_hours, 0.50),
    p90 = quantile(gap_hours, 0.90),
    p95 = quantile(gap_hours, 0.95),
    p99 = quantile(gap_hours, 0.99),
    max = max(gap_hours)
  )


```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

dat <- read_csv("final_whale_shark.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

tab <- dat %>%
  mutate(lc = as.character(lc)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lc)) %>%
  count(lc, sort = TRUE)

p1 <- ggplot(tab, aes(x = fct_reorder(lc, n), y = n, fill = lc)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Error type distribution (LC)",
    x = "Error type (lc)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "LC"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1, show.legend = FALSE) +
  expand_limits(y = max(tab$n) * 1.1)

print(p1)

p2 <- ggplot(tab, aes(x = fct_reorder(lc, n), y = n, fill = lc)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Error type distribution (LC)",
    x = "Error type (lc)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.1) +
  expand_limits(y = max(tab$n) * 1.1)

print(p2)

```


```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)

dat <- read_csv("final_whale_shark.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(datetime = ymd_hms(str_remove(as.character(date), "Z"), tz = "UTC"))


top9_ids <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), !is.na(datetime)) %>%
  count(id, name = "n_obs", sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 9) %>%
  pull(id)


gaps_top9 <- dat %>%
  filter(id %in% top9_ids, !is.na(datetime)) %>%
  arrange(id, datetime) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(gap_hours = as.numeric(difftime(datetime, lag(datetime), units = "hours"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(gap_hours), gap_hours >= 0)


p_linear <- ggplot(gaps_top9, aes(x = gap_hours)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  facet_wrap(~ id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Time gap distribution for top 9 IDs (by #observations)",
    x = "Time gap (hours)",
    y = "Count"
  )

print(p_linear)


p_log <- ggplot(gaps_top9 %>% filter(gap_hours > 0), aes(x = gap_hours)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~ id, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Time gap distribution for top 9 IDs (log10 x-scale)",
    x = "Time gap (hours, log10 scale)",
    y = "Count"
  )

print(p_log)


```


```{r}
# log10 x-scale version: shade the area to the right of vmax in red

vmax <- 2.7
max_x <- max(steps$speed_mps, na.rm = TRUE)

p_speed_redzone_log <- ggplot(steps %>% dplyr::filter(speed_mps > 0), aes(x = speed_mps)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 80) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = vmax, xmax = max_x,
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
    fill = "red", alpha = 0.20
  ) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = vmax, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Step speed distribution (log10 x-scale)",
    subtitle = paste0("Red shaded area = speed > ", vmax, " m/s (vmax)"),
    x = "Speed (m/s, log10 scale)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p_speed_redzone_log)


```
